budget: first 719 updates (= V4 epoch 1) of the sealed fold-0 schedule; LR curve over the full 1438
grid_rationale: probe_fold0_mps.json: at lambda=1, median ||g_contrast||/||g_task|| on visual LoRA = 0.90 -> grid targets ratio 0.1/0.3/1.0
selection_rule: Among V4-GC candidates with model_val canonical AUPRC >= AUPRC(V4-G) - 0.01, pick the largest model_val energy_in_gt (softmax(ell) mass inside GT, fractured images); ties within 0.005 -> smaller lambda. If none qualify, report and pick the smallest lambda.
caveat: model_val has ~57 fractured canonical images; AUPRC SE is about 0.04, so this is screening, not evidence. Test is never read.
